## Notes

Levels 0-20; XP to next level 1,000 at level 0 rising to 30,000 at 19; passion learning 35%, 100%, 150% and +8 or +14 mood during related work; decay above level 9 from 30 to 3,600 XP per day; daily cap 4,000 XP per skill, then gains x20%; construction speed 50% plus 15% per level; incapable work types.
